description: Regression corpus for Agent 1's link filters (Section 2/3): real show URLs that must never be dropped as listing or section pages, and real listing/section pages that should be. A static snapshot — add entries by hand as new real cases turn up; don't regenerate it, or a fixed miss could quietly leave the corpus.

fields.title: The link title a filter would see: the show title for known-good, the link text for known-bad (null when only the URL was seen).
fields.venue: Venue name as stored — listingPageTitleReason matches '<venue> Exhibitions' against it.
fields.kind: known-bad only: listing_page_saved_as_show | archive_link | section_link | venue_listing_page
